_comment: Inventory of the status checks the main and integrate/** rulesets should require, and what
each producing workflow must keep doing. tools/ci/workflow_policy.py checks the workflows
against it; the CI change guard uses the copy from the pull request's BASE commit.
Keep 'required_checks' in step with the ruleset settings (operator, separate approval).
pull_request_target is allowed only in 'pull_request_target_allowed' (the guard, which reads the pull request as data).
must_run entries starting with '=' pin a step's whole script: the steps that copy tools/ci/ from the base are pinned, so editing them is a policy finding.

'pinned_steps' is a closed, ordered list of whole steps for the gate jobs: each release check is identified by its step, not by a substring. After adding a release check, refresh it with: python3 tools/ci/workflow_policy.py --print-steps .github/workflows/release.yml gate

gate:
=set -euo pipefail
base=""
if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = pull_request ]; then base=$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^1) || base=""; fi
if [ -z "$base" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$base:tools/ci/release_scope.py" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "RELEASE TARGET: event '$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME' without a trusted scope script on the base: the full gate runs"
  echo "target=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-trusted"
rm -rf "$dir"; mkdir -p "$dir"
git archive "$base" tools/ci | tar -x -C "$dir"
python3 -I "$dir/tools/ci/release_scope.py" --event pull_request

gate.step: Release scope (what this event must check)

gate:
=set -euo pipefail
zero=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
case "$EVENT" in
  pull_request)
    if ! base=$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD^1); then echo "::error::HEAD is not the pull request's merge commit"; exit 1; fi
    trusted="$base" ;;
  push)
    base="$BEFORE"
    if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = "$zero" ]; then
      # A new branch: compare with, and take the rules from, where it left main.
      if ! base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD); then echo "::error::new branch without a merge base on origin/main"; exit 1; fi
    fi
    trusted="$base" ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::unexpected event $EVENT"; exit 1 ;;
esac
if ! git cat-file -e "$trusted:tools/ci/integration_gate.py" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::the base commit has no tools/ci/integration_gate.py; nothing trusted can judge this change"; exit 1
fi
dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-trusted"
rm -rf "$dir"; mkdir -p "$dir"
git archive "$trusted" tools/ci | tar -x -C "$dir"
if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
  python3 -I "$dir/tools/ci/integration_gate.py" --mode pr --head-ref "$HEAD_REF" --same-repo "$SAME_REPO"
else
  python3 -I "$dir/tools/ci/integration_gate.py" --mode push --base "$base" --head HEAD
fi

guard:
=set -euo pipefail
zero=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
case "$EVENT" in
  pull_request_target)
    # GITHUB_SHA is the base branch tip, the commit this workflow file comes from.
    trusted="$GITHUB_SHA"
    head=$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)
    if [ "$head" != "$PR_HEAD_SHA" ]; then echo "::error::checked-out commit is not the pull request head"; exit 1; fi
    if ! tree=$(git merge-tree --write-tree "$trusted" "$head"); then
      echo "::error::the pull request does not merge cleanly into its base; resolve the conflict first"; exit 1
    fi
    tree=$(printf '%s\n' "$tree" | head -n 1)
    merged=$(GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=ci GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=ci@example.invalid GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=ci GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=ci@example.invalid \
      git commit-tree "$tree" -p "$trusted" -p "$head" -m "merge for the CI change guard")
    base="$trusted"; event=pull_request ;;
  push)
    base="$BEFORE"
    if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = "$zero" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$base^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
      base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse HEAD^)
    fi
    trusted="$base"; merged=$(git rev-parse HEAD); event=push ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::unexpected event $EVENT"; exit 1 ;;
esac
dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-trusted"
rm -rf "$dir"; mkdir -p "$dir"
if git cat-file -e "$trusted:tools/ci/ci_guard.py" 2>/dev/null; then
  git archive "$trusted" tools/ci | tar -x -C "$dir"
else
  # Fail-closed: without the base's rules nothing trusted can judge this change
  # (only the push that merges the pull request introducing tools/ci/).
  echo "::error::the base commit has no tools/ci/ci_guard.py; nothing trusted can judge this change"; exit 1
fi
python3 -I "$dir/tools/ci/ci_guard.py" --event "$event" --base "$base" --head "$merged"
